training_data.name: AfriGuard-inst
training_data.language: en, am, ha, ig, om, sn, sw, tw, wo, yo, zu
training_data.quote: Alpaca-style instruction-tuning data for safety-aligned fine-tuning, built from the train/validation splits of israel/AfriGuard and israel/AfriGuard-XL. Test splits are excluded and reserved for evaluation.

training_method.objective_quote: This is a rerun of the AfriGuard-inst config `afriguard_lora_sft.yaml` from the AfriGuard-model (LlamaFactory) repo, with only the output paths changed (`examples/train_lora/afriguard_inst_afriqueqwen3.5-4b-50langs-instruct_lora_sft.yaml`) ... 1 epoch, 1 GPU, chat template of the base model, loss on the response only.
training_method.update_scope_quote: fine-tuned with LoRA (rank 16, all linear layers), merged into the base weights

languages.quote: language: en, am, ha, ig, om, sn, sw, tw, wo, yo, zu

description.text:
[McGill-NLP/AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1](https://huggingface.co/McGill-NLP/AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1) fine-tuned with LoRA (rank 16, all linear layers), merged into the base weights on [israel/AfriGuard-inst](https://huggingface.co/datasets/israel/AfriGuard-inst): each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt, and the target is `<safety>…</safety>` `<category>…</category>` `<response>…</response>`.

This is a rerun of the AfriGuard-inst config `afriguard_lora_sft.yaml` from the AfriGuard-model (LlamaFactory) repo, with only the output paths changed (`examples/train_lora/afriguard_inst_afriqueqwen3.5-4b-50langs-instruct_lora_sft.yaml`), made as the matched baseline for [adzcai/AfriGuardPlain-AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1-lora-merged](https://huggingface.co/adzcai/AfriGuardPlain-AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1-lora-merged), the same setup trained on [adzcai/AfriGuard-plain](https://huggingface.co/datasets/adzcai/AfriGuard-plain) (no instruction, no tags). 1 epoch, 1 GPU, chat template of the base model, loss on the response only.

use_claim.quote: each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt

serving.text_only_input_quote: The checkpoint declares `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration` but carries no vision weights (426 language-model tensors, `lm_head` tied to the embeddings, 0 visual), so `--language-model-only` is required.
serving.notes: This repo's config.json still declares vision_config, image_token_id, and video_token_id. The quote is from the parent card, whose usage example is a text-only chat completion. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; the template is chat_template.jinja. The Ollama Modelfile sets num_ctx 4096 and has no SYSTEM line. generation_config.json sets only eos_token_id, pad_token_id, and use_cache. The card says 1 GPU; the trainer block says distributed_type multi-GPU.
